name: telemetry_sdk
_comment: Delivery-policy owner for the telemetry lane (ADR-005/ADR-006). base_sdk owns TelemetryClient (the one client every SDK may import); this SDK owns WHEN/HOW events leave the device by injecting through TelemetryClient.configure's TelemetryTransport seam. No pages, no routes, no HTTP of its own: the composed shell's generated sdk-di block calls TelemetrySdkDependencies.register, which applies the default delivery policy (the base_sdk gateway POST) at boot. The frappe half (core/telemetry) is the backend: api_error_log + log_frontend_error/track_event whitelisted methods.
